items.name: SESI Rondônia Open 2020
items.information:
**PORTUGUESE**
A competição é reconhecida pela Associação Mundial de Cubo Mágico (WCA) e os resultados farão parte dos rankings oficiais.
Teremos premiações (medalhas) para os três primeiros colocados de cada modalidade.
Contamos com a colaboração de TODOS para tornar a competição mais fluida. Portanto, quando solicitado, prontifique-se para ser juiz, embaralhador ou runner.

**ENGLISH**
The competition is acknowledged by the World Cube Association (WCA) and the results will be ranked officially.
There will be prizes (medals) for the first three best results in each event.
We count on EVERYBODY's collaboration to make this competition more fluid. Therefore, when asked, please be ready to be a judge, scrambler or runner.

items.name: Please Be Solved Vancouver 2020

venue.name: [Irving K Barber Learning Centre](https://learningspaces.ubc.ca/buildings/irving-k-barber-learning-centre-iblc)
venue.address: Irving K Barber Learning Centre, 1961 E Mall, Vancouver, BC V6T 1Z1
venue.details: The competition will be held at UBC, on the second floor of IBLC in room 261.

items.information:
This competition has **only blindfolded** and **fewest moves** events. Spectators and competitors must **remain silent** whenever anyone is competing, to allow for concentration.
While you only need to show up for events/rounds that you are competing in, we would appreciate competitors being present for other events/rounds too when not inconvenient, to **help with judging**. If you have a parent or friend who can come judge, that would be great - it's not hard, even if you know nothing about cubing.

**Note about venue**: Unlike previous competitions held in UBC, this competition's venue is **not** at the Nest. The venue is located in IKB Learning Centre (see Venue Details), which is still quite close to the Nest.

items.name: Swisscubing Cup III 2020
items.information:
Swisscubing Cup IIl is part of the Swisscubing Cup 2020, made of 6 competitions during the whole year. Check out on https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2020/?lang=en for the details of the other editions.
A competitor who registers and doesn't show up at the competition will have to pay that registration fee at his next competition in Switzerland.

______________________________________________________________________________________________

Swisscubing Cup IIl ist Teil des Swisscubing Cup 2020. Dieser besteht aus 6 Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, besuche https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2020/.
Teilnehmer die sich registrieren aber nicht bezahlen, müssen die Teilnahmegebühr bei ihrer nächsten Competition in der Schweiz bezahlen.

______________________________________________________________________________________________

Le Swisscubing Cup IIl fait partie du Swisscubing Cup 2020, qui consiste de 6 compétitions tout au long de l'année. Allez voir sur https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2020/?lang=fr pour plus d'informations sur les autres autres manches.
Un compétiteur qui s'inscrit et ne vient pas à la compétition (sans nous l'annoncer à l'avance) devra payer des frais d'inscription supplémentaires à sa prochaine compétition en Suisse.
______________________________________________________________________________________________

Swisscubing Cup IIl da parte della Swisscubing Cup 2020, che è composta da 6 competizioni tenute durante l'anno. Qui (https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2020/?lang=it) trovi le informazioni relative alle altre edizioni. Un partecipante che si iscrive a una competizione ma non si presenta deve pagare la tassa di iscrizione alla sua prossima competizione in Svizzera.
